turns.prompt_text: would vinegar work as well as lemon juice
turns.response_html: It depends on the recipe, but in general, you can use vinegar as a substitute for lemon juice. Both are acidic, but lemon juice is a citric acid with a brighter flavor, while vinegar is an acetic acid with a sharper, more pungent taste. If a recipe calls for a small amount of lemon juice, vinegar can work well, but it may alter the flavor. As a general rule, use half the amount of vinegar for the required lemon juice, especially when baking.
